paper.title: Towards minimax policies for online linear optimization with bandit feedback

settings.name_in_paper: Online linear optimization with bandit feedback, finite action set of N actions
unmapped: Losses satisfy |a^T z| <= 1 for all (a,z) in A x Z (dual action set); number of actions N
Action set assumed full rank after preprocessing (John's ellipsoid)
settings.definition_quote: In this paper we are interested in the dual setting, where the adversary plays on a dual action set, i.e., $\cA$ and $\cZ$ are such that $|a^{\top} z| \leq 1, \forall (a,z) \in \cA \times \cZ$.

source.label: th:exp2john
source.quote: {\sc exp2} with John's exploration and estimate \eqref{eq:banditestimate} satisfies, for $\frac{\eta d}{\gamma} \leq 1$, $$R_n \leq 2 \gamma n + \frac{\log N}{\eta} + \eta n d.$$ In particular with $\gamma = \eta d$ and $\eta = \sqrt{\frac{\log N}{3 n d}}$ we have that $$R_n \leq 2 \sqrt{3 n d \log N} .$$

results.notes: N is number of actions (not experts); mapped to N_exp symbol declared. Regret is E sum a_t^T z_t - min_a E sum a^T z_t.

Then {\sc osmd} on $\cA$ with regularizer~(\ref{eq:entro-reg}) satisfies ... In particular, with $\gamma = 2 d \sqrt{\frac{\log 2}{3 n}}$ and $\eta= \sqrt{\frac{\log 2}{3 n}}$, $R_n \leq 2 d \sqrt{3 n \log 2}$.

extra_assumptions: gamma = 1/sqrt(n), eta = sqrt(log n/(2 n d))

source.label: th:ball
source.quote: Consider the online linear optimization problem with bandit feedback on $\cA = \{x \in \R^d: \|x\| \leq 1 \}$, and with $\cZ = \{x \in \R^d: \|x\| \leq 1 \}$. Then {\sc osmd} on $\cA' = \{x \in \R^d: \|x\| \leq 1-\gamma \}$ with the estimate \eqref{eq:ballestimate}, and $F(x) = - \log (1 - \|x\|) - \|x\|$ satisfies ... In particular, with $\gamma = \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}$ and $\eta= \sqrt{\frac{\log n}{2 n d}}$, $R_n \leq 3 \sqrt{d n \log n}$.

results.notes: Paper describes the method as efficient.
